Alyssa: quick check-in on stream-settling policy after the RFC. question: when a hedge/backup request fires for a multiplexed connection, what do we do with sibling streams? immediate cancel, bounded drain, emit checkpoint, or try cooperative handoff?
Marco: bounded drain is my preference. immediate cancels are user-visible and messy. but bounded drains need sane limits or we'll OOM.
Tiago: agree bounded drain + checkpoint option. propose enum: immediate, bounded (tokens/ms), checkpoint (emit header + small state), cooperative (send hint and yield if upstream acknowledges). default bounded with strict caps.
Jen: can we make it per-route and per-plan? e.g., search routes get immediate; conversational routes get checkpoint. ops wants global safety caps.
Nadia: checkpoint semantics matter: what does the upstream need to persist? suggestion: keep KV-prefix + last-ack-offset only. header name: `x-rw-checkpoint: v1;offset=12345;window=10s`
Sam: logs in staging: `edge: settle stream conn=0x77 id=0x9f;mode=bounded;tokens_drained=96;reason=hedge`. saw p50 improve for search, p99 regressed slightly.
InfraBot: deployment: edge-settling-experiment v2 rolled to canary at 3344556688 :rocket:
Marco: we need a per-connection slot budget: max_drain_tokens and max_drain_ms enforced by slot manager. if exceeded, escalate to immediate abort.
Tiago: also need backpressure safety: if connection has >N active streams, reduce drain budget per-stream to keep memory bounded.
Alyssa: telemetry: add fields `settle_mode`, `drain_tokens`, `checkpoint_emitted`, `fallback_behavior`. break down by route and plan.
Jen: staging numbers: bounded default reduced error rate for long-poll endpoints 20% but increased memory pressure by ~6% at peak. with per-conn caps that should be manageable.
Nadia: Compatibility: checkpoint is advisory. Gateway must gracefully fall back if upstream doesn't ack checkpoint within window. fallback options: retry-safe-variant, or return degraded partial result to client.
Sam: quick implementation note: trailers vs headers? trailers are better for streaming but many proxies strip them. maybe negotiate via `x-rw-resume-hint` header at start, then send `x-rw-checkpoint` trailer if negotiated.
Alyssa: agreed. action items: (1) enum + defaults doc, (2) slot-manager caps + admission algorithm, (3) checkpoint header/trailer negotiation spec, (4) telemetry + dashboard, (5) canary experiment plan with pxx targets. I'll draft the follow-up RFC tonight and ping owners. :thumbsup:
